actions.action: Separate findings by population and scope
actions.mechanism: Structured scope prevents similar wording from collapsing findings about different populations into one apparent contradiction.
actions.implementation: Attach exact stored passage IDs, population, outcome, timeframe, and finding direction to each claim. Mark unstated scope as unspecified.
actions.check: Enter opposing findings for adults and adolescents; verify separate claims and a visible population difference survive summarization.
actions.risk: Inferred scope could misrepresent passages; require confirmation of extracted fields.

actions.action: Expose disagreement in a passage comparison panel
actions.mechanism: Side-by-side evidence distinguishes opposing findings within matching scopes from findings whose scopes differ.
actions.implementation: Add claim-pair comparison showing scope differences and exact linked passages in an in-workspace drawer; allow users to mark relationships unresolved.
actions.check: Compare opposing adult and adolescent claims, then matching-population opposites; verify scope difference and disagreement remain distinguishable and originals open inline.
actions.risk: Automated pairing may miss relevant claims; retain manual comparison.

actions.action: Keep missing evidence separate from opposing evidence
actions.mechanism: Explicit evidence states prevent an empty search or unfilled slot from becoming a negative finding.
actions.implementation: Separate supporting passages, opposing passages, and no linked evidence. Require exact passage IDs for either evidence-bearing category; restrict lookup to stored passages.
actions.check: Remove every opposing passage; verify the interface says no opposing evidence linked, not that the claim is confirmed.
actions.risk: Labels describe this board, not all available research.

actions.action: Validate scope and citations before briefing export
actions.mechanism: Statement-level checks keep compression from silently broadening claims or deleting recorded disagreements.
actions.implementation: Build briefing statements from supplied passages with exact passage IDs. Flag omitted population qualifiers and linked opposing findings; require revision or explicit qualification.
actions.check: Draft a universal statement from opposing adult and adolescent findings; verify export requires scoped wording and accessible citations for both findings.
actions.risk: Semantic checks can miss overreach; preserve human review without ranking source truth.
